info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Vesuvian Battery Detail-v1-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the management of detailed information related to Vesuvian batteries within the product catalog. It allows users to create and submit new detail records effectively, ensuring that product offerings are comprehensive and up-to-date. Typical consumers of this API include inventory managers and marketing teams who require accurate product descriptions for various channels. By streamlining the detail management process, this API enhances product visibility and supports strategic sales initiatives.
